name: definition node
definition: A typed in-substrate definition d=(id,kind,A,B,parameters,dependencies,phase,provenance,hash).

name: reference resolution
definition: Resolve every definition_ref and dependency ID; order dependencies before dependents.

name: ordered composition
definition: Composition is serialized and non-commutative; execute the stored order without re-sorting.

name: zero-based position
definition: ordinal = offset + 1; the stored timeline coordinate remains the zero-based offset.

name: log-polar chart
definition: rho=ln(r/r0), theta=atan2(y,x); runtime consumes quantized rho/theta already compiled.

name: contiguous 64-bit key
signature: rho20 x theta18 x X14 x phi12 -> K

name: Morton 64-bit key
signature: rho20 x theta18 x X14 x phi12 -> KM
definition: Interleave MSB round-robin: rho19,theta17,X13,phi11,... until all 64 bits are consumed.

name: LUT cell lookup
definition: Resolve a canonical key in the sorted cell table; compiled graph mode may use direct successor indices.

name: literal zero field
definition: Z_D(K)=0 for every K in the finite domain D of definable cells; Z_D(K)=bottom otherwise.

name: one-bit reduction
definition: P(w)=popcount(w) mod 2.

name: one-bit jitter
definition: j=P(mix32(seed xor K_hi xor rotl(K_lo,13) xor X xor aux)); sigma=2j-1; selected state field += sigma*a.

name: first discrete difference
definition: Delta q_n=q_n-q_(n-1).

name: second discrete difference
definition: Delta^2 q_n=v_n-v_(n-1); Delta^2 phi is the angular acceleration coordinate.

name: lower-case phi hinge
definition: phi is periodic in Z/(2^12 Z); capital Phi is reserved for the golden ratio and is not the runtime phase.
source_basis: SCLP symbol contract; lower-case phi source

name: timeline phase
definition: X is a 14-bit modular tick; wraps contribute to lineage while the tick remains periodic.

name: analytic cone relation
signature: packed chart x cone parameters -> signed relation
definition: r=max(rho_min-rho,rho-rho_max,|cyclic(theta-theta0)|-alpha_q); inside iff r<=0.

name: swept cone family
definition: F_sweep(x)=inf_u d_C(x-s(u)); a compiled profile may tabulate the path as KIN2 cells.

name: circle/radial shell
definition: A circle is a radial shell in the packed chart and an axial projection of a cone.

name: spherical support
definition: Packed shell residual is max(|rho-rho0|-dr, |cyclic(phi-phi0)|-dphi); Euclidean helper is ||x-c||-R.

name: lens intersection
definition: Shared domain is exact conjunction/intersection; it may be used as a join key or connector locus.

name: reflective Klein wrap
definition: On an odd radial wrap: rho'=rho mod N_rho, theta'=N_theta/2-theta, phi'=-phi, orientation'=orientation xor 1; optional sheet flip.

name: half-turn bundle
definition: On an odd wrap: theta'=theta+N_theta/2, phi'=-phi, orientation'=orientation xor 1.

name: radix branch
definition: Select one canonical key bit; repeated selections form a radix-trie path.

name: typed hinge
signature: branch x state x map -> state
definition: H=(pivot/state,map0,map1,invariant); runtime map0 is identity and map1 is the cell's declared delta plus optional orientation/sheet flip.

name: binary L-system step
definition: Apply chirality-signed turn and dyadic velocity scaling, corresponding to F(T)->F(T/2)[+/-phi F(T/2)].

name: binary successor
definition: i_(n+1)=next_i[bit].

name: state patch
definition: Execute exactly one opcode, normalize periodic fields, select successor, and update lineage.

name: symbolic projection
definition: Emit a side-view pyramid, circle, sphere, action, class, or other downstream token without making projection the substrate.

name: deterministic output
definition: Set the output token and emitted bit; optional halt is a program semantic, not a safety mode.

name: replay lineage
signature: state x cell x key -> u32
definition: ell'=mix32(ell xor payload xor aux xor K_hi xor rotl(K_lo,7) xor branch xor cell_index).

name: explanation trace
definition: Return ordered cell IDs/opcodes, branches, keys, residuals, outputs and lineage.

name: active-bit projection
definition: A(n)={k | bit_k(n)=1}; the original numeric value is retained.

name: active-bit cardinality
definition: Return the number of active positions in a finite binary word.

name: typed equality predicate
definition: Return 1 exactly when two values of the same declared type are equal; the result is a branch bit, not an identity rewrite.

name: Pascal parity
definition: C(n,k) mod 2 defines a deterministic triangular occupancy pattern.

name: pulse geometry
definition: m declared pulses map to one point, a segment, a triangle for m=3, or a regular m-gon.

name: compiled rule
definition: Translate exact predicates into RADIX/CONE/SPHERE/HINGE branches and EMIT leaves.

name: deterministic inference
signature: program x state x ticks -> output,trace
definition: Run the finite operator graph for the requested number of ticks or until an EMIT/HALT cell.

name: hot state record
definition: 64-byte state: four coordinates, four velocities, orientation/sheet/branch/cell, lineage/output/residual/status.

name: LUT cell record
definition: 48-byte cell: key, opcode/flags, four signed args, two successors, payload, aux.

name: portable CPU evaluator
definition: Dependency-free Python oracle and C99 evaluator implement identical integer semantics.

name: portable GPU step
definition: One invocation executes one TOMAGI transition using only 32-bit integer storage and bit operations.
